prompt:
A flat, matte design sketch of a desktop website homepage, landscape 16:9, shown straight on with no perspective, no device frame, no browser chrome, no drop shadows, no gloss, no photorealism. Deliberately unfinished, like a designer's layout study rendered in flat color blocks.

Palette, used exactly: warm aged-paper off-white background (#F7F3ED), dark warm ink for text (#2A231C), one muted slate blue accent used sparingly (#365778). No other colors. A very faint regular dot grid sits over the paper background.

The page is composed like a printed ledger sheet or a preparation form, not like a marketing site.

Layout, top to bottom:

A thin quiet header strip across the very top, with the word Narraitor small on the left and a few small greeked navigation items on the right.

Below it, a serif headline across the left half reading exactly: Play a story in any world you can imagine

Under it, one short line of greeked text.

Then the main structure, filling most of the page: four numbered rows stacked vertically, running the full width, each row separated by a thin full-width hairline rule, like ruled lines on a ledger.

Each row has the same anatomy, left to right: a large outlined serif numeral in the far left margin (1, 2, 3, 4 as actual legible numerals), then a short greeked heading line in slightly heavier weight, then two greeked body lines beneath it, then in the right portion of the row a small bracketed marker.

Row one is visually emphasized above the others: give it a subtly different paper tone or a thin slate blue rule at its left edge, and place one solid slate-blue rectangular button inside that row on the right side. Row one is the only row with a colored button.

Rows two, three and four are quieter, with only a small outlined marker where row one has its button.

At the bottom, below the last hairline, a small block showing a rough greeked preview of a page of prose, indicated as a bordered rectangle filled with soft indistinct horizontal lines, sitting beside two short greeked caption lines.

A thin footer strip at the very bottom with three small greeked links.

The only legible text anywhere is the word Narraitor, the headline, and the numerals 1, 2, 3, 4. Every other text region is greeked: soft indistinct horizontal lines standing in for words, not real letters. Do not render invented prices, dates, statistics, logos, faces, or photographs.

The overall feeling is a well-printed form or checklist on good paper, calm and orderly.
